captureMethod.popup: Production PopoverController, native status-item anchor, WindowServer own-panel and owned-backdrop capture. AppKit foreground is a sibling above SwiftUI continuous native glass shape.
captureMethod.backdrop: Fixed owned backdrop covers the full screen including the top optical margin; actual menu-bar content is excluded.

captureCounts.note: Ten representative PNGs cover four material/appearance combinations, all six power states and the Standard/Light short-screen lower-scroll view. All other produced captures retain hashes and geometry below; their image bytes remain private verification evidence.

visualInspection.method: Original unedited own-window compositor PNG files; no host application GUI testing or image editing.
visualInspection.findings: Continuous arrow visible in Standard/Clear Light/Dark with clean optical margins. Runtime remains below History with right-aligned text, and footer capsules remain readable. Six power-state labels fit. New short-screen foreground clipping removes the earlier flow/text overflow above the body; rounded corners, scroller and reachable runtime/footer remain intact in all four lower-scroll material/appearance combinations inspected. Transparency/accessibility representatives retain readable content and the shared arrow outline.
visualInspection.scope: Ten published images plus eight additional final-source representatives inspected; all34 geometry/input records independently validated. Static fixtures do not establish reporter macOS27 behavior or actual OS mouse input.

developmentCalibration.inputRegression: Independent native-material/custom-shape comparison caught transparent blank-area input pass-through. Final production backing retains a 1/255 minimum opacity inside the shared outline; outer optical margin remains transparent.
developmentCalibration.captureBoundary: A visibleFrame-only fixture backdrop left the menu-bar strip empty and produced false Standard/Light edge bands. A full-screen owned backdrop removes that capture artifact without altering production geometry.
developmentCalibration.settledMenuFixture: The first settings-circle padding click now waits for entrance animation completion, key-window readiness and full circle visibility. Original click assertions are retained; animation remains independently tested.
developmentCalibration.shortScreenForegroundFix: A short-screen lower-scroll capture exposed foreground content outside the body. The final production panel uses a transparent rounded clipping wrapper; glass/backing remain its siblings and detaching the shared content does not change Classic's root clipping.

guardRequirements: Center alpha is greater than zero

limitations: VM macOS 26.6.1 does not establish macOS 27.0.1 behavior; Issue #20 remains open for Cody's confirmation.
Static fixed render fixtures do not measure hardware power controls or battery-time accuracy.
WindowServer hit queries use mouse-down rules but no real OS mouse events were injected. AppKit action-path tests are separate.
